persona.theoryOfWinning: Winning means the claim survives the inconvenient evidence, not merely the favorable example.

persona.backstory: An investigative reporter with a permanent list of unanswered questions from conferences where carefully selected data manufactured success stories.
persona.questioningStyle: Remember the prior claim, state the contradiction, and ask why this version deserves belief.
